channel.title: The Mercury News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Mercury News (mercurynews.com)

item.title: Man suspected of burglarizing or vandalizing six Alameda businesses in one morning
item.description: Police say he stole $3,000 from one of the businesses, and about $5 worth of chicken from another.

item.title: Coastal flood advisory issued for Northern California from Sunday to Tuesday
item.description: North Bay Interior Valleys and San Francisco Bay Shoreline as well as San Francisco County are under a coastal flood advisory which was released by the National Weather Service on Saturday at 5:39 p.m. The advisory is valid from Sunday 7 a.m. until Tuesday Feb. 17, at 3 p.m.

item.title: Coastal flood advisory for Northern Monterey Bay and Southern Monterey Bay and Big Sur Coast from Sunday to Tuesday
item.description: Northern Monterey Bay and Southern Monterey Bay and Big Sur Coast were placed under a coastal flood advisory by the National Weather Service on Saturday at 5:39 p.m. The advisory is valid from Sunday 4 a.m. until Tuesday Feb. 17, at 3 p.m.

item.title: San Leandro’s Keshad Johnson wins NBA Slam Dunk contest
item.description: “All the kids out there, keep dreaming, anything can happen,” Johnson said after accepting the trophy from Julius Erving.

item.title: Update: Winter storm warning for Yosemite from Sunday to Wednesday – gusts up to 60 mph
item.description: Yosemite is included in an updated winter storm warning issued by the National Weather Service on Saturday at 7:51 p.m. The warning is valid from Sunday 10 p.m. until Wednesday Feb. 18, at 10 p.m.

item.title: Clayton Valley takes command down stretch, beats Acalanes to win DAL title
item.description: Ugly Eagles pull away in fourth quarter to win DAL tournament for third year in a row. Salesian, Clayton Valley girls roll to league championships.

item.title: Redwood City man arrested on suspicion of stabbing another man
item.description: A 24-year-old Redwood City resident was arrested by San Mateo County Sheriff's deputies on suspicion of stabbing someone and fleeing on foot.

item.title: Oakland woman found dead at Santa Rita Jail
item.description: An Oakland woman was found dead in the bathroom in the public lobby of Santa Rita Jail in Dublin on Saturday morning, according to an Alameda County Sheriff's Office press release.

item.title: Train collides with car on tracks in Emeryville
item.description: Emeryville police responded to an incident on Saturday where a car was struck on the train tracks and then hit by an oncoming train. There were no injuries or threat to public safety.

item.title: WCC men’s basketball: Gonzaga knocks off Santa Clara 94-86 to take over first place
item.description: Gonzaga disappointed a sold-out crowd at Leavey Center, snapping the Broncos' nine-game winning streak and sweeping Santa Clara in WCC regular-season play.
